README.md.content:
# Prepared Conductor virtual-payload control

Status: **executed after the project campaign; 3 tests PASS** on 1 November 2026,
runtime `86ad3b70b5b834d60bc0fe96a91091174265c827`. This is a reduced-model
mechanism reproduction, not a reproduced project cause. The original Kotlin
control source was unchanged. The first attempt found no test because the
external init used a composite task path as a project selector; the corrected
selector found the included-build module. Only the external init changed.
No analyzer configuration, main source, or repository test source changed.

## What this control is intended to establish

The real Conductor run-4 captured this family:

```text
A:  ret.[Map#MapValue].* / FLOW
Dc: ret.[any] / FLOW
Dp: taskId.* / FLOW
B:  taskId.[StrTokenizer#<rule-storage>]
          .[HeaderElementIterator#<rule-storage>].[Map#MapValue].* / FLOW, NORMAL
C5: taskId.[StrTokenizer#<rule-storage>].[any] / FLOW, DEMAND
FL(B)=3, FL(Dp)=0, budget=1
```

The Kotlin source uses the actual common-core engine, call stages, current
summary pub/sub, C2, C5 and post-statement storage. It uses
`FiniteProgramFixtures` and `ProductionSchedule`. It is a **reduced untyped IR
model**, not a real-JIR replay. In particular, it gives the payload variable
Object semantics. It does not treat the real String taskId as an Iterator,
assert that a synthetic field is physically valid on String, or prove that
all three metadata alternatives were selected at one project statement.

The selected serialization blocks are:

- H: HeaderElementIterator `next.*`, with root and one-field storage copy.
- I: Iterator.next, with its one-field Element copy.
- S: StrTokenizer.next, with root and one-field storage copy.
- V: Map.get, used to derive the MapValue accessor in the sink/query.

`extract_metadata.py` is a narrow read-only extractor. It rejects any action
that is not a this-to-result root/one-field copy. It writes the exact YAML
blocks, line ranges, source hashes, JSON and TSV. The test reads TSV and
checks every full YAML source hash before lowering the actions. It does not
invoke a provider-selection oracle or invent a deep method summary.

The root has an entry source and an exit sink. Its only injected sink seed
is `ret.MapValue.$/T` (depth 1). The helper uses an explicit paired query
`Dc=ret.[any]/FLOW, Dp=arg(1).*/FLOW`. The root ZERO permission is an explicit
test query input. No saved record, predefined method model, deep seed, or
precomputed deep relation is supplied.

## Expected observation and failure policy

The two loop variants must generate the exact mixed `S.H.V` depth-3 family
at the helper entry, with a NORMAL FLOW result. The engine must admit the
short `S.[any]` DEMAND image. The test does not merely call ApOps on a deep
handwritten summary. The raw candidate must come from actual engine
processing and the admitted edge must be present in actual inferred summary
state. It also replays the pure gate on that observed candidate to print its
complete A/B/Dc/Dp witness.

The LOOP_ONLY variant checks real point observations before and after the
modeled next call: `x.H.V` at call point 3 and `x.S.H.V` at backward successor
point 2, under the same original. The S YAML action has the inverse
`result.P -> this.S.P`. In this reduction, the call is the only operation
that can add S; moves only rebase. This identifies the creator relation in
the reduced model. COMBINED retains this observation but does not claim that
this pair alone identifies a unique asynchronous parent among recursive
results.

RECURSION_ONLY keeps a recursive call with an acyclic local CFG. It asserts
the same admitted budget and prints the observed body language. It does not
assert an unmeasured H.H.H or S.H.V result in that negative control. This
separates local pumping from bounded recursive-summary feedback.

**Do not weaken the LOOP_ONLY/COMBINED S.H.V assertion if it fails.** Keep
that failed receipt. Determine whether C2, call projection, model identity,
summary coverage, or the reduced CFG removed the route. A failure means the
prepared control does not yet reproduce the captured family. It is not
permission to inject a deep predefined summary or relabel an illustrative
AP operation as a project reproduction.

## Executed receipt and portable rerun

- First attempt: Gradle exit 1, `No tests found`; Kotlin test compile was
  UP-TO-DATE. The test did not execute. Its stdout/source snapshot is in
  `execution-first/`.
- Second attempt: Gradle exit 0, 3 tests / 0 failures / 0 errors, 0.300 s
  XML suite time. Only the external init project selector was corrected.
- LOOP_ONLY: 402 processed helper observations, maximum body field depth 3,
  4 admitted helper summary leaves, 1 subscription.
- COMBINED: 2,191 observations, maximum body depth 3, 16 admitted leaves,
  163 subscriptions.
- RECURSION_ONLY: 79 observations, maximum body depth 2, 4 admitted leaves,
  2 subscriptions. The exact depth-3 family is not asserted for this control.
- Both loop variants generated the exact mixed S.H.V NORMAL body candidate
  and the S.ANY DEMAND admitted summary. Their actual point observations
  include x.H.V at call point 3 and x.S.H.V at point 2, under one original.
- Test XML, stdout, command, full Gradle log, and pre-run source snapshots
  are copied under `execution-second/`.

The init script adds this directory to the target module's test source set.
It takes its location from a command property; no file copy to the
repository's test tree is needed. From the repository's `core` directory:

```sh
./gradlew :opentaint-dataflow-core:opentaint-dataflow:test \
  --tests org.opentaint.dataflow.bidi.ConductorVirtualIteratorGrowthControlTest \
  --console=plain -I "$conductor_control_dir/conductor-growth-control.init.gradle" \
  -Dopentaint.conductorGrowthMetadataDir="$conductor_control_dir"
```

The report artifact embeds every control file, all YAML blocks, the full
source YAML, the extractor, both attempt receipts, and an extraction script.
Extract its `portable_control_files` into an empty directory, then set
`conductor_control_dir` to that directory. The pinned repository provides
its normal production-engine and fixture/build dependencies. The metadata
hash check rejects a different model source; it does not silently rewrite it.

No new project run, heap setting, alias switch, mark mode or field-limit
schedule experiment was part of this control. Its one run is backward
**run-4**, limit 3, with FULL runtime policy.

## Relation to the project evidence

A successful test would reproduce a mechanism and an exact captured field
family in a smaller production-engine model. It would not prove the
project's unique creator instruction or its model selection. A real-JIR
reduction of the original ParametersUtils loops, actual resolver choices,
and alias paths remains a stronger follow-up. The project profiles and
body counts must still establish that the reproduced mechanism explains a
material part of project work.

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Copy four real serialized model blocks; do not run the analyzer or tests."""
import hashlib,json,sys
from pathlib import Path
repo=Path(sys.argv[1]).resolve();out=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
choices=[
 ('H','model/java/config/org.apache.httpcomponents-httpcore-4.4.16.yaml',
  ['class: HeaderElementIterator','pattern: next.*']),
 ('I','model/java/config/stdlib/java-util.yaml',['- function: java.util.Iterator#next']),
 ('S','model/java/config/org.apache.commons-commons-lang3-3.14.0.yaml',
  ['- function: org.apache.commons.lang3.text.StrTokenizer#next\n']),
 ('V','model/java/config/stdlib/java-util.yaml',['- function: java.util.Map#get\n']),
]
rows=[]
for key,rel,selectors in choices:
 p=repo/rel;src=p.read_text();ls=src.splitlines(True)
 starts=[i for i,l in enumerate(ls) if l.startswith('- function:')]+[len(ls)]
 blocks=[(a,b,''.join(ls[a:b])) for a,b in zip(starts,starts[1:])]
 found=[(a,b,s) for a,b,s in blocks if all(x in s for x in selectors)]
 if len(found)!=1:raise RuntimeError((key,'Expected one actual YAML rule',len(found)))
 a,b,block=found[0];(out/(key+'-serialized-model.yaml')).write_text(block)
 # This deliberately narrow extractor handles only this -> result payload
 # copy actions in the pinned blocks. It rejects any different schema.
 actions=[]
 lines=block.splitlines();i=0
 while i<len(lines):
  line=lines[i]
  if line.startswith('  - from:'):
   rest=line[len('  - from:'):].strip(); parts=[]
   if rest:parts=[rest];i+=1
   else:
    i+=1
    while i<len(lines) and lines[i].startswith('    - '):parts.append(lines[i][6:].strip());i+=1
   if i>=len(lines) or lines[i].strip()!='to: result':raise RuntimeError((key,'Not a selected this/result model',parts,lines[i:]))
   if parts[0]!='this' or len(parts)>2:raise RuntimeError((key,parts))
   if len(parts)==1:actions.append({'from':'this','path':[],'to':'result'})
   else:
    q=parts[1]
    if not q.startswith('.') or len(q[1:].split('#'))!=3:raise RuntimeError((key,q))
    owner,name,typ=q[1:].split('#')
    actions.append({'from':'this','path':[{'owner':owner,'name':name,'type':typ}],'to':'result'})
  i+=1
 if not actions:raise RuntimeError((key,'No actions'))
 rows.append({'id':key,'source':rel,'source_sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),
  'start_line':a+1,'end_line':b,'copied_block_sha256':hashlib.sha256(block.encode()).hexdigest(),'actions':actions})
(out/'metadata.json').write_text(json.dumps({'schema':'four-pinned-serialized-models-v1','rules':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'rows':len(rows),'actions':sum(len(x['actions'])for x in rows),'output':str(out/'metadata.json')}))

with (out/'metadata.tsv').open('w') as f:
 f.write('# id\tsource\tsourceSha256\tfirstLine\tlastLine\tfrom\tto\tmodifier\n')
 for row in rows:
  for a in row['actions']:
   mod='-' if not a['path'] else '.'+a['path'][0]['owner']+'#'+a['path'][0]['name']+'#'+a['path'][0]['type']
   f.write('\t'.join(map(str,[row['id'],row['source'],row['source_sha256'],row['start_line'],row['end_line'],a['from'],a['to'],mod]))+'\n')

from pathlib import Path
import json, sys, hashlib
artifact = json.loads(Path(sys.argv[1]).read_text())
out = Path(sys.argv[2]).resolve()
out.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
for relative, item in artifact["portable_control_files"].items():
    target = out / relative
    if not target.resolve().is_relative_to(out):
        raise ValueError(relative)
    raw = item["content"].encode("utf-8")
    assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() == item["sha256"]
    target.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    target.write_bytes(raw)
print(out)
